### 기업소개

쿼드마이너는 내부 정보 유출 등의 보안 위협을 해소하고, 사이버 보안 시장에 체계적으로 대응하고자 합니다. 국내 유일의 차세대 네트워크 보안 솔루션을 개발중에 있으며, 네트워크 이상 행위 분석, 실시간 트래픽 분석, 감사 등의 기능을 제공하여 네트워크 환경의 가시성을 제공합니다.  
이미 잘 나가는 스타트업으로 2년 만에 높은 매출을 달성하고 있으며, 해외로부터 지속적인 영업 요청이 오고 있습니다. CIO Outlook에서 올해 Cyber Security 솔루션 부문에 선정할 정도로, 혁신적인 제품이기도 합니다. 급격하게 성장하고 있는 우리 회사에 바로 지금 합류하세요!

## Analyze every movement in the digital world and provide intuitive insights.

Capture network traffic reliably with a high-performance full-packet database and gain visibility through AI-driven analysis of big data.

## Proactively hunting and responding to hidden cyber threats with specialized tactical insights.

Identify latent threats and propose proactive countermeasures using expert-driven analysis of threat group tactics and a matrix supported by definitive forensic data.

## Protect your digital assets from known and unknown threats with intelligent network forensics technology for packet analysis and threat detection at its core.

 Network Blackbox

 APTRCENTER

### Full packet-based cyber threat hunting solution [...] Learn more

### Integrated file quarantine system to respond to advanced persistent threats (APTs)

APTRCENTER determines whether the original file is malicious and responds to all files distributed externally and internally. It visualizes the flow of file data by collecting files in various file transmission and reception environments and provides an integrated analysis and response system for files through integration with various dynamic/static analysis equipment.

Learn more

### Quad Miners are building trust in various industries.

Quad Miners' Solution

### Manufacturing

Enhance security and increase operational efficiency without interrupting production lines with protocol analysis and anomaly detection capabilities optimized for ICS environments.

Learn more

### Healthcare [...] Learn more

### Healthcare

It helps to quickly detect abnormal signs occurring in the medical network and ensure the confidentiality and integrity of patient data.

Learn more

### Government

Rapidly identify threat actors who have infiltrated government networks, block the spread of attacks, and support rapid decision-making in crisis situations.

Learn more

### Financial Services

Provides threat detection and response capabilities specialized for financial networks, protecting core assets of financial institutions and facilitating regulatory compliance.
